inventory_boundary: Frozen 1,217 GitHub Actions artifacts; later artifacts are outside this inventory.
source_identity_rules: Workflow run heads, native COMMIT/source declarations, all artifact-name commit identities and explicit metadata source fields remain separate categories.
The outer artifact metadata boundary is finite and explicit. Absent or null markers are retained; no source is substituted from a workflow head.
Every declared source reference in this dataset is a full 40-character commit SHA, resolved to one real Git commit object.
External engine, GitHub Action and model revisions, private storage identifiers and Git blob IDs are classified separately rather than used as Havenline commit parents.
Embedded source checksum declarations are retained as declarations; exhaustive inner ZIP versus Git tree equivalence is not claimed.
